decision.title: XSLT streamability analysis (packet 7.6a)
decision.summary: src/xslt_streamability.c runs XSLT 4.0 chapter 19's streamability analysis over the stylesheet AST after lowering, raising XTSE3430 only for constructs proven not guaranteed-streamable, while evaluation stays unstreamed.

body.p: , after , , , , . Replaces 's "streamable="yes" runs unstreamed" by the analysis of XSLT 4.0, chapter 19 (whose rules are XSLT 3.0's chapter 19); evaluation stays unstreamed until 7.6b.

item.p: Where: src/xslt_streamability.c, called once from sxml_xslt_compile after lowering, over the sealed stylesheet AST and the XPath ASTs of its expressions, patterns and value templates (the same trees lowering reads; no tree of its own). Not over the IR: chapter 19 classifies by syntax production, and lowering rewrites paths, // and value templates. A frame machine with explicit stacks in allocator memory, no recursion (); a construct needing more than 100,000 frames is uncertain.

What: each construct's posture, sweep and U-type (glossary , , ): the general rules (19.8.1) with operand usages, choice operand groups and higher-order operands; every instruction of 19.8.4; stylesheet functions by category with streaming parameters (19.8.5); attribute sets (19.8.6); value templates (19.8.7); the XPath expressions of 19.8.8 (paths with scanning expressions, axis steps with rule 4, filters, unions, for and quantified expressions, maps, lookups, dynamic calls, inline functions and named references); the table of 19.8.9 and its special functions (accumulator-after and -before, current, current-group, last, root, outermost, the higher-order functions refined by an inline function's signature); motionless patterns (19.8.10). Verdicts: template rules of streamable modes, by import precedence of xsl:mode (6.6.4); xsl:source-document (18.1); functions with a category; attribute sets (10.2.3); accumulators, their values type-adjusted by the declared type and capturing rules (4.0, 19.9) grounded (18.2.9); merge sources (15.4). The first not guaranteed-streamable is XTSE3430 at the construct (19.10).

Uncertain: where sxml has no rule (an extension function, a function the 19.8.9 table does not list, keyword arguments, a dynamic call without a visible signature, a binding sxml cannot trace, XPath 4.0 constructs chapter 19 does not know), the assessment is uncertain unless the operand is grounded, and an uncertain verdict is never an error: sxml rejects nothing on a guess (19.10 lets a processor stream more than the rules guarantee).

Beyond the letter of chapter 19, as the XT40 cases expect: E//T is E/descendant::T when T's predicates are plainly non-positional; "." is a pattern step (./descendant::a/b scans); xsl:copy select is assessed as xsl:for-each over the selection (19.8.4.12 would make the content higher-order); xsl:fork with at most one consuming prong takes the general rules (one prong may return streamed nodes); current-group() of a grounded population is grounded and motionless anywhere, and of a group around a streamed xsl:source-document grounded inside it; intersect and except with a motionless right operand keep the left operand's posture; one for or some binding over streamed nodes is S ! R with the variable as "."; a reference to the streaming parameter inside a higher-order operand is free-ranging (19.8.4.30, note); an instruction with XSLT 1.0 behaviour is roaming; xsl:map with duplicates (4.0) takes the general rules; group-starting-with and group-ending-with must be motionless patterns.

Driver: the XSLT driver claims the feature streaming and no longer streaming-fallback, which needs an option sxml does not have (Proposed); the feature and the strm group stay outside the denominator. system-property-013 (streaming satisfied="false") is therefore not applicable.

Measured (release driver, whole XT40, ed905be and 8a8fd58): passed 8,952 to 11,792. The 2,936 cases that need the feature streaming, not run before, 2,841 passed (2,681 with the feature claimed and no analysis, at f12ac89); 154 of the 156 that expect XTSE3430 pass; the strm group 2,503 of 2,564 (97.6 %). Every other case as before (system-property-013 now not applicable: 8,952 to 8,951).

Not done, left to 7.6b: streamed evaluation itself (the receiving task fed by the parser, ); the two XTSE3430 cases the analysis misses (sf-filter-001, marked _WRONG in the suite; si-fork-953, sorted groups in xsl:fork, which 19.8.4.19 allows); supports-streaming; the fallback option. 7.6b can read the verdicts: a guaranteed-streamable mode or source document is what it may stream, and the postures name what each construct selects.
